Requires its returned request_id and a fresh request_key for this intended turn; identical retries reuse that key. Uses Elora credits and publishes additive revisions.

tools.name: open_elora_drawing
tools.description: Open an authorised existing drawing revision in the embedded 2D/3D viewer; may prepare and cache a missing preview without changing drawing geometry. tools.description: Read up to 100 signed, replayable notifications retained for 30 days. Deduplicate by event id, preserve next_cursor across reconnects and honour poll_after_seconds (15) and rate limits (30/minute/connection). tools.description: Read the latest committed revision after a human save, change summary, paged object IDs, units, optional placement and per-revision export availability. Saving is not completion. Open open_url for the existing authenticated editor; reread after the human saves. No geometry or terrain is changed.

tools.name: get_elora_edit_batch
tools.description: Poll the same durable save until applied, no_change, failed or refused. On success reread current state before the next edit or export. This only reads the requesting user's batch.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cad_capabilities, search_cad, prepare_cad_downloads, get_elora_drawing_request, get_elora_workflow_events · Private data: get_cad_capabilities, search_cad, get_cad_equipment, generate_elora_drawing, continue_elora_drawing, open_elora_drawing, export_elora_drawing, get_account_cad_download, check_elora_connection · Public sink: get_cad_capabilities, search_cad, get_elora_workflow_events, apply_elora_drawing_edits · Destructive: get_cad_capabilities, get_cad_equipment, export_elora_drawing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cad_capabilities, search_cad, prepare_cad_downloads, get_elora_drawing_request, get_elora_workflow_events · Private data: get_cad_capabilities, search_cad, get_cad_equipment, generate_elora_drawing, continue_elora_drawing, open_elora_drawing, export_elora_drawing, get_account_cad_download, check_elora_connection · Public sink: get_cad_capabilities, search_cad, get_elora_workflow_events, apply_elora_drawing_edits · Destructive: get_cad_capabilities, get_cad_equipment, export_elora_drawing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
